title: Detention and correctional facilities.
officialText:
In detention and correctional facilities, common use areas that are used only by inmates or detainees and security personnel, and that do not serve holding cells or housing cells required to be accessible pursuant to
Section 1107.5.5, are not required to be accessible or to be on an accessible route.
